title: Run the FR-40 brain packet experiment
body:
Operator 2026-10-27 (ADR 0014 D20): FR-40 replaces the Wizard-of-Oz experiment; `evals/woz/` stays only as a harness pilot and is not run. About 40 tasks reconstructed from historical BLOCKING review findings, each checked by its fix commit's test; arms A (no packet), B (packet from records dated before the task base) and S (the same budget of static AGENTS.md standards); one Codex gpt-6-luna session per run with the repository AGENTS.md on in every arm; stop after 20 tasks if B is not ahead. Pre-registered: GO for packets if B−A ≥ +15 pp (p < 0.05, tokens ≤ +25%); GO for retrieval and brain v2 if also B−S ≥ +10 pp; KILL if the 90% CI upper bound of B−A < +10 pp.
Acceptance: frozen manifest committed before the first run; all arms run or are reported invalid with reasons; results table and threshold verdicts recorded.

Operator 2026-11-08: GO ("kurwa no zgadzam się, rób eksperyment"). The lead runs the validity.json alternative: synthetic convention tasks with deterministic checks (74–132 independent units), same A/B/S arms and thresholds; ADR 0014 D20 amended in the manifest slice. Decision: .krn/runs/lead/decisions.md 2026-11-08.
Slices: t-k83jr28 (tasks+scorers) → t-bsb9d9z (packets) → t-j5xq3zn (manifest, score, report) → t-v3wy363 (run, verdict).

Decision 2026-11-08 (lead, operator grant "decyduj i leć"; .krn/runs/lead/decisions.md): fixed strata. The claim is restricted to the seven recorded conventions; templates are fixed strata; the primary test is a stratified exact McNemar over the 133 units with a per-template table. t-j5xq3zn encodes it in the manifest and amends ADR 0014 D20.
